roleContext.roleTitle: Quality Analytics Specialist, Automotive Parts Plant
roleContext.jobDescription: The automotive parts plant stamps and assembles body components for two vehicle makers under their supplier quality agreements. The Quality Analytics Specialist analyses the plant's inspection and scrap data, runs the statistical process control charts for the critical characteristics, prepares the monthly supplier quality report for the customers, investigates capability drops with the line supervisors, and documents each investigation's boundaries. Corrective actions are approved by the plant quality manager. Reports to the plant quality manager; works with the line supervisors, the metrology lab and the customers' supplier quality engineers. Both customers audit the plant's quality data annually, so the reports and investigation files must be traceable to the quality system records.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Quality Analytics Specialist, Automotive Parts Plant

## Experience

- Quality analytics specialist at a body components plant for four years, analysing the plant's inspection and scrap data and running the statistical process control charts for the twenty-two critical characteristics on the two stamping lines.
- Prepared the monthly supplier quality report for the plant's two customers under their supplier quality agreements, with the reports accepted by both customers' supplier quality engineers each month.
- Investigated capability drops with the line supervisors under the plant's investigation procedure, running the measurement studies with the metrology lab; the corrective actions were approved by the plant quality manager.
- Provided the corrective action data to the plant quality manager for each investigation, recording in the investigation file which analyses were mine and which belonged to the supervisors.
- Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each investigation file, filed with the plant quality manager's approval record.

## Work samples

- Work sample: one month's control charts for one stamping line, one monthly supplier quality report and one investigation file with its approval record, with the quality system references as a verification trail.
